termination.reason: Cross-task grounding was proven and the next gap was stable: the learner repeatedly guessed joint vectors and issued out-of-range gripper targets without a geometry-to-grasp planner.

transfer_result.conclusion: The G6 cross-task generality claim is supported for distinct solid-color tabletop objects under calibrated RGB-D.

evidence: The learner sent fourteen servo calls using hand-guessed joint arrays.
Three gripper commands exceeded profile bounds.
No grasp was sensor-verified and the task remained unsuccessful.
